description.value: Big Hot is SFU Burnaby's first and only hot pot location, operating as a takeout stall inside the MBC Food Court on top of Burnaby Mountain. Cyclists who complete the demanding climb to campus can build a custom bowl from 44 fresh ingredients using a Hong Kong-inspired soup base. It is a distinctive, filling refuel option in an otherwise limited food landscape at the summit.

address.value: MBC Food Court, 8888 University Drive, Burnaby, BC V5A 1S6

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands at 82m; stands at 92m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The SFU website confirms Big Hot is a real, operating hot pot takeout stall in the MBC Food Court at SFU Burnaby campus; OSM tag takeaway=only is corroborated by the website's build-your-own bowl description. OSM diet:vegetarian=yes is plausible given the 44-ingredient hot pot format, but no explicit mention of vegetarian labelling appears on the website page. No bike parking, water refill, or washroom details appear in either the OSM tags or website content; the OSM community field 'North Vancouver' is incorrect — coordinates and website both place this in Burnaby.
